notes: Read AGENTS.md and research/CONTRACT.md and all four systems-engineering role files. Inspected merged implications for all 13 distinct candidates (nine discovery, four diamond); source files were not edited.

Independent source coverage: at least one official venue source for every candidate. Direct official pages were read for 11 venues; Engineering Management Journal and International Journal of Production Research were checked through official indexed text because direct retrieval returned 403. This is bounded agent review, not human scientific or usability review.

Checked every verified_free certification against its explicit journal-specific fee exclusion (four of four). No cost demotion was warranted: four diamond routes remain verified_free; nine subscription routes remain needs_verification. A no-APC alternative alone is insufficient to exclude submission/page charges. No registration, membership or selective waiver was inferred.

All five reported acceptance-rate figures were independently corroborated: Systems Engineering 8% (2025), SRBS 15% (2025), EMJ 6% and IJPR 12% (last full calendar year, 2025), SoSyM 23.96% (2025, denominator unspecified). Wiley/T&F use final decisions, including desk rejection, not the submission cohort. SoSyM's 466 submissions are not an established denominator.

Removed 11 null-valued metric placeholders across nine records through complete metrics-array replacements; retained every non-null value and its existing year/population caveats. Missing or disputed values remain described in audit notes. Undated policy timing and undated citation displays cannot support same-period comparisons. Not every retained non-acceptance statistic was independently remeasured or reverified.

Difficulty was challenged separately from citation impact. Reliability Engineering & System Safety, Requirements Engineering, and SoSyM are demoted from high to unknown because their present evidence does not establish a comparative band. Research in Engineering Design retains high based on explicit broad-generalizability/desk-rejection rules; defined journal rates support retaining the other labeled judgments. Unknown does not mean easy.

Review/format gaps corrected for Research in Engineering Design, IJPR and SoSyM; current SoSyM tool route documented. JEMC AI and copyright boundaries remain material manuscript-specific conditions. OSRI scope fit is a research judgment for computational, methodological, synthesis or existing-data work; it does not authorize new clinical practice or physical laboratory work.
No human approval, venue contact, submission, remote write, merge, deployment or publication was performed.
